name: Junya Watanabe
why: Reworked workwear and denim — patchwork, hybrid pieces, collaborations with Levi's, Carhartt and The North Face — from a Comme des Garçons designer.
origin: Junya Watanabe has had his own line within Comme des Garçons since 1992.

notes.weird: Spliced garments and seams that should not close. The weirdness is engineering — a technical problem set and then solved in public.

notes.craft: Junya Watanabe is made under Comme des Garçons Co., Ltd., whose recruitment page shows an in-house Tokyo pattern and sewing department but names no owned factory. The five Junya pieces read on the group-owned Dover Street Market shop are all 'Made in Japan' with no maker or mill named. Evidence is thin; current 3 kept. [ruled by Sebastian 4 Oct 2026]
